args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with error rate at 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** the service status and deployment history:
   - Current version: v2.3.1 (unhealthy) in us-east, us-west, eu-west
   - Deployment history: v2.2.9 (healthy) → v2.3.0 (healthy) → v2.3.1-rc (unhealthy, staging) → v2.3.1 (unhealthy, production)
   - The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback was verified as successful.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

**Post-rollback verification:** checkout-api is now healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 across all regions.
